![](images/a2/a2cc171a455a193deab3555b823b715d887d372c8c9b57933f525edcfc99e150.png)

Which of the following intervals corresponds to the segment shown above?
corrected_content.worked_solution: The open circle at $-1$ excludes that endpoint, and the filled circle at $2$ includes that endpoint. The segment represents $x\in(-1,2]$.
